meta.name: structured-plan-mode
meta.description: This skill should be used when planning and tracking complex feature implementations that require systematic task decomposition. Use this skill to break down large features into manageable, well-documented tasks with clear dependencies, action items, and success criteria. The skill provides a structured template and methodology for iterative planning and tracking throughout implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大型特性分解为可管理任务并追踪进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在复杂特性开发中系统化拆解任务
copy.tagline_en: Break down large features into manageable tasks and track progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically decompose tasks in complex feature development

howto.what: 帮你把复杂的开发任务拆成一步步的计划：先调研，再定方案，最后列出具体任务，每完成一步会让你确认后再继续。
howto.when: 当你需要实现复杂功能（涉及多个组件、需要调研方案）时，或者在写代码前希望系统性地规划步骤时触发。

say.text: 帮我用结构化计划模式规划这个新功能
say.note: Claude 会开始创建计划模板并逐步引导。

say.text: 我们来调研一下这个功能的实现方案
say.note: Claude 会进入调研阶段，询问需求。
Claude 会要求你选择一个方案并填充计划文档。

howto.what_en: Helps you break down complex feature implementations into step-by-step plans: first research, then decide on approach, finally list tasks. It confirms with you before moving to the next step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to implement a complex feature (multiple components, requires research), or when you want to systematically plan steps before coding.

say_en.text: Help me plan a new feature using structured plan mode.
say_en.note: Claude will create a plan template and guide you step by step.

say_en.text: Let's research implementation options for this feature.
say_en.note: Claude will enter research phase and ask questions.

say_en.text: End research and select the approach.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to choose an approach and fill the plan document.
